---
title: "Icons"
description: >
  The full shadshiny icon set, rendered live, and how to use icon names across
  buttons, badges, menus and items.
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
for (p in c("_common.R", "../_common.R", "vignettes/_common.R"))
  if (file.exists(p)) { source(p); break }
```

shadshiny ships a small, curated icon set drawn from
[Lucide](https://lucide.dev) — enough to cover the components without pulling in
a font or an icon package. Reference an icon **by name** anywhere a component
takes an `icon` argument, or render one directly with `shad_icon()`.

> Icon names are validated. Passing a name that isn't in the set below throws an
> error rather than rendering nothing, so typos surface immediately.

## Using icons

```{r, echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
shad_icon("search")                                   # a bare 16×16 SVG
shad_button("Search", icon = "search")                # leading icon
shad_button(icon = "plus", size = "icon")             # icon-only button
shad_badge("Verified", icon = "check")                # in a badge
shad_menu_item("mail", "Send mail", icon = "mail")    # in a menu
shad_sidebar_item("inbox", "Inbox", icon = "mail")    # in the sidebar
```

Get the full list programmatically with `shad_icon_names()`.

## The set

Every icon in the package, at its native size. The name under each is exactly
what you pass to `icon =`.

```{r}
tags$div(
  class = "shad-icon-grid",
  lapply(shad_icon_names(), function(nm) {
    tags$div(class = "shad-icon-cell",
      shad_icon(nm),
      tags$code(nm))
  })
)
```

## Sizing & colour

Icons inherit the current text colour (`currentColor`), so they tint themselves
to whatever context they sit in — wrap one in a coloured element and it follows.
They render at `1rem` by default; to resize a standalone icon, pass an inline
`style` through `...` (it overrides the default sizing), or attach the
`shad-icon--sm` / `shad-icon--lg` class.

```{r}
demo({
  tags$span(style = "color:var(--shad-primary)", shad_icon("circle-check"))
  tags$span(style = "color:var(--shad-destructive)", shad_icon("triangle-alert"))
  shad_icon("loader", style = "width:2rem;height:2rem")
})
```

## Missing an icon?

The set is intentionally minimal. For anything outside it, pass your own SVG (or
any tag) wherever an `icon` argument is accepted — the constructors take a tag
just as readily as a name:

```{r, echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
custom <- htmltools::tags$svg(
  xmlns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", viewBox = "0 0 24 24",
  width = "16", height = "16", fill = "none", stroke = "currentColor",
  `stroke-width` = "2", htmltools::tags$path(d = "M12 2v20M2 12h20")
)
shad_button("Custom", icon = custom)
```
